title: Gradient
description: Specification for temperature gradient profiles where temperature changes linearly over time or distance.

end_value.title: end_value
end_value.description: Final temperature value at the end of the gradient.

length.title: length
length.description: Duration or distance over which the gradient is applied.

length_unit.title: length_unit
length_unit.description: Unit of measurement for the gradient length (time or distance).

measurement_points.title: measurement_points
measurement_points.description: Description of how temperature is measured along the gradient.

start_value.title: start_value
start_value.description: Initial temperature value at the beginning of the gradient.
